sourcePreview.title: Introducing Vendo. Now every user gets their own personalized agentic experience of your product. Try it now 👇
Introducing Vendo (YC S26), the customization layer that lets your users build their own features and micro-apps on top of your product For 50 years, software has been shipped one way for everyone.
Announcing the Vendo Full Stack Agentic Interface: an embeddable agent that lives right inside your product, with everything you need built-in.
